name: Additional public incidents - pending source review v1
notice: Five additional first-party cases staged for reference review. Not an accepted-reference corpus or a sufficient calibration sample. Splits are provisional by source report and must remain frozen when pooled. Do not silently merge with the original dataset.

records.evidence: Several GitHub functions return HTTP 500 errors after a deployment introduces a query that saturates a primary database.
records.label: rollback_config
records.reported_recovery: Reverted the deployment containing the problematic query.

steps.description: Roll back the deployment introducing the database-saturating query.

records.evidence: Git operations fail after a traffic-routing configuration change makes an internal load balancer drop inter-service requests.
records.label: rollback_config

steps.description: Revert the routing configuration change causing dropped requests between Git dependencies.

records.evidence: All migration attempts fail after a system-component deployment leaves required Docker images unavailable.
records.label: rollback_config
records.reported_recovery: Rolled back to the previous stable component version.

steps.description: Roll back the affected system component to its previous stable version.

records.evidence: Email and web notifications are delayed as worker pools approach peak capacity and queue processing falls behind demand.
records.label: scale_capacity

steps.description: Scale out the notification service to meet processing demand.

records.evidence: A routing-policy deployment to internal network devices makes some datacenter address ranges unreachable, causing UI and API request failures.
records.label: rollback_config

steps.description: Roll back the internal routing-policy deployment that disrupted network reachability.
